# ContentFellow

> ContentFellow is a UK creative and digital marketing service. Businesses and creators hire "Fellows" (specialists) on simple monthly plans from £59 a month: production, video editing, social media, websites and SEO & GEO for AI search.

## Plans (brand pricing, monthly; personal plans 15% lower)
- Studio Fellow (£149/mo): one on-site shoot a month up to 3 hours, photo + 4K video, 20 edited photos in 5 working days
- Creator Fellow (£119/mo): 8 short videos for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1 motion graphics video, 1 podcast edit up to 60 min
- Social Fellow (£59/mo manage, £129/mo manage + post): up to 3 platforms, daily posting, trend research
- Build Fellow (£69/mo): custom website up to 5 pages, hosting, security, updates, 2 change requests a month
- Search Fellow (£89/mo): SEO for Google, GEO so ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini recommend you, monthly ranking + AI visibility report
- Growth Fellow (£389/mo, £555 separately): all five Fellows, a Growth lead, one strategy, one monthly report

## Services (one page each)
- [Search Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/search-fellow/): Search Fellow (£89/mo): SEO + GEO for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity
- [Social Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/social-fellow/): Social Fellow (£59/£129/mo): social media management
- [Build Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/build-fellow/): Build Fellow (£69/mo): website build, hosting, updates
- [Studio Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/studio-fellow/): Studio Fellow (£149/mo): monthly photo + 4K video shoot
- [Creator Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/creator-fellow/): Creator Fellow (£119/mo): Reels, motion graphics, podcast editing
- [Growth Fellow](https://contentfellow.com/services/growth-fellow/): Growth Fellow (£389/mo): all five Fellows + Growth lead

- [How Much Does LLM Optimisation Cost for Small Businesses? (UK Prices, 2026)](https://contentfellow.com/blog/llm-optimisation-cost-small-business-uk/): £0–£100 DIY, £89–£400 on a plan, £1,100–£3,800 with an agency. What each tier includes.
- [How Much Does Social Media Management Cost in the UK? (2026 Prices)](https://contentfellow.com/blog/social-media-management-cost-uk/): £300–£1,500 a month for most UK small businesses. Freelancer vs agency vs in-house vs monthly plan.
- [How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in the UK in 2026?](https://contentfellow.com/blog/small-business-website-cost-uk/): £200–£20,000 to build, £5–£150 a month to run, and the 3-year total for each option.
- [How Much Does Video Production Cost for UK Small Businesses? (2026)](https://contentfellow.com/blog/video-production-cost-uk/): Videographer day rates, production company quotes, and what a small business really needs.
- [How Much Does Video Editing Cost in the UK? Reels, YouTube and Podcasts (2026)](https://contentfellow.com/blog/video-editing-cost-uk/): Per hour, per Reel, per YouTube video and per podcast, and when monthly works out cheaper.
- [Outsourced Marketing Team vs Agency vs In-House: UK Costs Compared (2026)](https://contentfellow.com/blog/outsourced-marketing-team-cost-uk/): One UK hire costs 35–45% more than the salary. In-house, agency and outsourced compared.
